gold_note: Two-column strict consensus: the MANIRAPTORA arrow at the foot of the left column joins the Maniraptora node at the top of the right column, encoded as one tree. Read by eye in quadrants. Each capitalised clade name sits just left of the stem entering the node it names and is kept, in title case (MANIRAPTORA, printed twice, once). Polytomies: Dinosauria (four), the sauropodomorphs (Buriolestes, Eoraptor and the rest), the herrerasaurs (four), Bicentenaria-Compsognathus-Sinosauropteryx node (four), Paraves (four), Avialae (three), the anchiornithids, the Chongmingia trio, Ornithothoraces (three), Ornithuromorpha (five), the Gansus-Iteravis node and Carinatae. The unnamed node joining Chilesaurus to Neotetanurae and the Coelurus and Ornitholestes ladder carry no names. 131 tips, 12 polytomies (4, 3, 4, 4, 4, 3, 3, 3, 3, 5, 3, 3 children); 25 printed clade names kept as internal node labels. Sample 8 case (census 2, seed 20261251). Topology transcribed from the figure image and checked node by node; topology only.
